sentences.en: After inspecting the farm, he went to see the goats and their young herdsman.
sentences.zh: 检查完农场后，他去看了山羊群和他的年轻牧羊人。

sentences.en: Yanni's father was a Tuareg herdsman.
sentences.zh: 亚尼的父亲是一位图阿雷格族牧人。

sentences.en: The herdsman rode his horse across the vast plain.
sentences.zh: 牧人骑着马穿越了广阔的平原。
